card.name: City edges and outskirts, sizes of cities
card.fires_on: Words that place something at the edge of or outside a city ("on the northern edge of London", "outside the city"), and the space before a number giving a city's area, size or population.

modes.label: Outside the city
modes.description: Words saying a place lay at the edge of or beyond a city or its gates.

modes.label: City size figures
modes.description: The slot just before a number for a city's area, population or wall length.
modes.example: The population of Baghdad as of 2011 is approximately<< >>7,216,04
